combinationDescription: Mutation + selective DAG closure + contradiction + shared administrative/risk state + cross-event isolation

atomicFeatureDecomposition.description: Evidence mutation changes an existing event state
System identifies dependency closure caused by mutation
Only affected downstream nodes are recomputed
Contradictory evidence remains represented rather than deleted
Multiple events contribute to same administrative state
Multiple events contribute to same risk state
Mutation of Event A updates shared administrative/risk state
Mutation of Event A does NOT rewrite Event B event hypothesis
Mutation of Event A does NOT rewrite Event B spatial state
Resulting shared state remains traceable to contributing events
